mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nick_name as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, ru.nick_name as replyUserName FROM tb_post_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_student u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_student ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.parent_id = 0 THEN c.id ELSE c.parent_id END, c.parent_id, c.create_time
